target: Existing P6 rendered opening text; preserve source-owner canonical data and P5/P6 provenance

proposals.issue: The source names indiscipline and its intellectual-pride cause; the present voice says the candidate actively disdains obedience.

current.en: A spirit that disdains obedience, however learned or ardent it appears, is a danger in one who would serve at the altar.
current.fr: L'esprit d'indépendance qui méprise l'obéissance est dangereux chez celui qui veut servir à l'autel.

suggested.en: Indiscipline, particularly when fostered by intellectual pride, is a danger in one preparing for the priesthood.
suggested.fr: L'indiscipline, particulièrement lorsqu'elle est nourrie par l'orgueil de l'esprit, est dangereuse chez celui qui se prépare au sacerdoce.

proposals.originalText: la indisciplinatezza e ciò che la genera, l'orgoglio della mente

proposals.issue: The admonition on hasty laying on of hands is explicitly St Paul's teaching to Timothy quoted by Pius X.

current.en: We urged bishops not to lay hands hastily upon candidates, even where their zeal seems abundant.
current.fr: Nous avons exhorté les évêques à ne pas imposer les mains avec précipitation, si grand que paraisse le zèle d'un candidat.

suggested.en: We recalled the Apostle's warning to Timothy against hastily laying hands upon candidates; zeal alone cannot substitute for discernment.
suggested.fr: Nous rappelions l'avertissement de l'Apôtre à Timothée de ne pas imposer les mains avec précipitation : le zèle ne remplace pas le discernement.

proposals.issue: The original comparison lists Gregory the Great, John Chrysostom and Anselm, while both language drafts omit Chrysostom.

suggested.en: Gregory the Great, John Chrysostom and Anselm
suggested.fr: Grégoire le Grand, Jean Chrysostome et Anselme

proposals.originalText: Gregorius Magnus, Ioannes Chrysostomus et Augustanus Anselmus

proposals.issue: The reply's last sentence describes an app visitor and historical authenticity, breaking the papal-study narrative voice. Transparency belongs in source-drawer/interface text.

current.en: These are principles of Our published encyclical, not a claim that We privately answered this visitor in person.
current.fr: Ce sont les principes de Notre encyclique publiée, non la prétention d'avoir personnellement répondu au visiteur.

proposals.displayPolicy: Preserve a prominent, non-speech label outside character dialogue: EDITORIAL ADAPTATION — NOT A HISTORICAL QUOTATION (and French equivalent).
